newsitem.title: USA: Greenbrier sees Q3 EPS about $0.03 to $0.06.
newsitem.headline: Greenbrier sees Q3 EPS about $0.03 to $0.06.

text.p: Greenbrier Cos Inc said Wednesday it sees its earnings for the third quarter ending May 31 in the range from $0.03 to $0.06 per share, which is below analysts' expectations.
Greenbrier said its third quarter earnings are impacted by competition, as well as by losses from its autostack and logistics operations.

The company said it expects improved manufacturing earnings beginning in its fiscal fourth quarter ending August 31. It also said new orders and a more favorable product mix should help the fourth quarter.
Greenbrier Cos, is a supplier of transportation equipment, logistics and services to the railroad industry.
